$comment: Feature flags (plan 14.4). A feature ships as stage "beta" (on in beta builds, off in stable) and is promoted to "stable" in a later release. Stage "experimental" is off in every channel until the user turns it on; a flag with requiresAudit stays experimental until security/crypto-audit.json names a published external audit report (plan W11.S1). since.beta is the first beta that had it; since.stable the release that turned it on for everyone. Checked by `npm run flags:check`. Names and descriptions are i18n keys flag.<id>.name and flag.<id>.desc.
